This includes animations for greetings, celebrations, and responses to audience interactions, ensuring that the mascot feels like a part of the stream. The final product will not only be visually appealing but will also be seamlessly integrated into the streaming platform, allowing for smooth interactions. This project is perfect for streamers looking to elevate their content and create a memorable experience for their audience.
